dialogues.jp:
「……ったく、どうして今日に限ってＨＲ延び
　るかなぁ」
dialogues.en:
A girl with a white bow on her head was sitting on the bench
and playing her instrument joyfully.
dialogues.text:
A girl with a white bow on her head was sitting on the bench
and playing her instrument joyfully.

dialogues.jp: 昇降口で靴を履き替え、外に飛びだす。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「遅いです。約束破りました……遅刻です」
dialogues.en: "You're late. You didn't come here on time......"
dialogues.text: "You're late. You didn't come here on time......"

dialogues.jp:
手元を見ていた顔をあげ、ちょっと拗ねたよう
な甘えた顔を見せる。
dialogues.en: She looked up and showed me a spoiled sulky face.
dialogues.text: She looked up and showed me a spoiled sulky face.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめん、待った？」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. Did I make you wait long?"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. Did I make you wait long?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、１０分ほど待ちました」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はは……ごめん、ＨＲが延びちゃって」
素直な返答に笑みが漏れた。
dialogues.en: I smiled as she answered in a straightforward manner.
dialogues.text: I smiled as she answered in a straightforward manner.

dialogues.jp:
暖かな陽気の中、心地よい風がふたりの間を過
ぎ去っていく。
dialogues.en:
A comfortable wind was blowing in between us in the warm
weather.
dialogues.text:
A comfortable wind was blowing in between us in the warm
weather.

dialogues.jp:
あの日、空の睡眠薬のビンを見たときは、本当
に生きた心地がしなかったけど……。
dialogues.en:
I thought everything was over when I saw an empty bottle
that day......
dialogues.text:
I thought everything was over when I saw an empty bottle
that day......

dialogues.jp:
｛いま／最近｝の睡眠薬が、飲んでも死なないように作ら
れてて良かった。萌も、より深い眠りにつこう
としただけみたいだし。
dialogues.en:
I'm glad that sleeping pills nowadays are made so they don't
kill people. Moe-sempai was just trying to get some good
sleep.
dialogues.text:
I'm glad that sleeping pills nowadays are made so they don't
kill people. Moe-sempai was just trying to get some good
sleep.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、本当に逝ってしまったとしても幼な
じみに会えるから――と、後から｛き／訊｝いたときに、
言っていたけど……。
dialogues.en:
Although she did tell me later that she didn't care if she
died. She thought she would be able to see her childhood
friend then.
dialogues.text:
Although she did tell me later that she didn't care if she
died. She thought she would be able to see her childhood
friend then.

dialogues.jp:
結局、萌にとってはどっちに転んでも良かった
のだろう。
dialogues.en: Moe didn't care whether she lived or died.
dialogues.text: Moe didn't care whether she lived or died.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、不慮の事故ということで」
dialogues.en: "Just think that you had an unlucky accident."
dialogues.text: "Just think that you had an unlucky accident."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「もう、仕方ないですね」
溢れんばかりの、ウキウキとした笑顔だ。
dialogues.en: She gave a big, excited smile.
dialogues.text: She gave a big, excited smile.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、前から不思議に思ってたんだ
　けど、なぜいつも木琴を持ち歩いてるの？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, I was always wondering why you carry your
xylophone around with you."
dialogues.text:
"By the way, I was always wondering why you carry your
xylophone around with you."

dialogues.jp: 「邪魔っしょ？」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「秘密です」
わざと子供じみたブーイング。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「嘘です」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「思い出の……品なんです」
dialogues.en: "This holds a lot of my memories......"
dialogues.text: "This holds a lot of my memories......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……なるほど」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いい……ですよね」
ちょっと、気遣うような声。
俺はニッコリと優しく微笑む。
「言ったろ。『忘れる必要なんかない』って」
dialogues.en: "I told you that you don't need to forget about him."
dialogues.text: "I told you that you don't need to forget about him."

dialogues.jp: 「それに、俺にとっても恩人だし」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「｛・・・／アイツ｝がいたから、俺は萌に会えたわけだか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "Because of him, I was able to meet you."
dialogues.text: "Because of him, I was able to meet you."

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・／アイツ｝が守ってくれたから。
感謝しなくっちゃ。
dialogues.en: I have to be thankful for him.
dialogues.text: I have to be thankful for him.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
少し昔を懐かしむような、優しげな眼差し。
dialogues.en:
She had a soft look in her eyes as she reminisced about her
past.
dialogues.text:
She had a soft look in her eyes as she reminisced about her
past.

dialogues.jp:
視線を落とし、日の光を受け光沢を放っている
木琴に、目を細める。
dialogues.en: She looked down at the xylophone shining in the sunlight.
dialogues.text: She looked down at the xylophone shining in the sunlight.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ行こうか、萌！」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
◆ＥＤ・忘れなくていいから◆

放課後、中庭に向かって足を運ぶ。ＨＲが延び
延びになって、少し遅れてしまった。
dialogues.en: I changed my shoes at the exit and ran outside.
dialogues.text: I changed my shoes at the exit and ran outside.

dialogues.jp:
そこに萌はいた。いつもの、独特な木琴の音色
を奏でて、幸せそうな笑みを浮かべて、俺を待っ
ていた。

｛・・・／アイツ｝との思い出の木琴。それを持っていても
いいかと問われた。俺はもちろん、構わないと
言った。

今日萌がこうして俺の横にいてくれるのは、一
重に｛・・・／アイツ｝のおかげだからだ。
そして、俺たちは手を取り合って歩き出した。
dialogues.en:
I gradually heard the off sound of an instrument. That sound
always makes me smile.
dialogues.text:
I gradually heard the off sound of an instrument. That sound
always makes me smile.
